answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Blessed midwife accreditation with midwives college attestation. It demands an accreditation the college renews after birth audits, and the haven is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so an accreditation the college renews after birth audits stays private; the canyon is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The ledge is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
